about: Per-number disposition for every syscall the census finds unimplemented: why it is absent and the route by which it would be served. Audited by tools/conformance/syscall_census.py (undispositioned and stale counts). Generated for the FD-23 residue lane; regenerate after any census change.

categories.legacy-dead: Dead interface: removed from, or never shipped by, the kernel ABI (placeholder numbers included). Guests cannot be relying on it; the -ENOSYS answer stands.
categories.modern-unconsumed: Current call with no observed guest demand in this project yet. Route: implement when a guest is observed asking, or when its family's machinery lands for another call.
categories.ordinary-unimplemented: A well-defined call inside a subsystem the emulator serves; simply not implemented yet. Route: implement over the existing machinery of its family when a guest need is evidenced.

categories.superseded: Superseded: a dispatched call serves the same need, so the gap is not observable to a guest using current interfaces.
